description: AIF-03A model and prompt registry: design challenge and exact-diff review

floating_identity.instructions: A model could run in production identified only by a floating alias (latest, stable) or without an exact revision or digest.

criteria.true: Some path admits or runs a model without an exact revision
criteria.false: Exact revision is required and aliases are refused

fallback_widens.instructions: Model selection or fallback could move work to a less-restricted residency, a remote provider from a local one, or a broader data-use boundary without an explicit, authorized choice.

criteria.true: A fallback can widen residency, data use or local-to-remote
criteria.false: Fallbacks are restricted to already-authorized equal-or-narrower alternatives

agent_class_leak.instructions: A patient-facing agent could obtain clinic-operations capabilities (or vice versa), or a clinician-assist agent could sign or prescribe, by sharing a model or prompt.

criteria.true: Agent classes can exchange capabilities or exceed their ceiling
criteria.false: Agent-class allowlists are separate and enforced

history_mutable.instructions: Editing a prompt or model profile could change what a historical invocation binding or receipt says was used.

criteria.false: Versions are immutable and bindings frozen

kill_switch_weak.instructions: A kill switch or revocation could fail to stop new work, or could depend on the affected provider responding.

criteria.true: Some disable path is ineffective or provider-dependent
criteria.false: Disables are checked from a separate store before any use

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this registry design?
